question: What's the best portable hi-fi speaker under $200?
query: best portable Bluetooth speakers under $200 sound quality reviews 2026

replays.text:
**Best pick: JBL Flip 7**, assuming it’s under $200 where you’re shopping. What Hi-Fi? names it its best portable Bluetooth speaker and notes that it supports wired USB-C playback of up to 24-bit/96kHz lossless audio—a useful perk if sound quality is the priority. It’s also rated for up to 14 hours per charge, with Playtime Boost adding up to two more. ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-bluetooth-speakers-portable-speakers-for-every-budget?page=1))

It’s a compact portable speaker, so don’t expect the scale or separation of a good home stereo—but for a carryable all-rounder, it’s my pick. SoundGuys also includes the Flip 7 in its under-$200 speaker roundup. ([SoundGuys](https://www.soundguys.com/best/the-best-bluetooth-speakers-under-200/))

**Best pick: JBL Flip 7**, assuming you mean a portable Bluetooth speaker. It should fit under $200 at typical pricing, but check the current price before buying.
